intersections.note: Carll runs along the left edge; only its south (sheet-right) face is drawn: block line x~283 west of Western, x~202 east of Western (a ~13 ft jog, also seen on sheet 520). Point = Western's axis (40 ft leg, lines y 1952/2192) at the mean of Carll's two axes (25 ft left of each block line). Western is 50 ft north of Carll (sheet 520). Same crossing as sheet 520 (405,2407)
Baltimore (60 ft) ends at Western Av. where Western turns from the 60 ft diagonal to the 40 ft north leg; point on Baltimore's axis at the diagonal's axis (the 10in and 6in water pipes meet here)
Fenner ends at Baltimore just above the Linden/Boardman corner (bottom edge); its SE face meets Baltimore at the corner lot 2687
Grove runs from Liddell to Fenner only
Fenner bends here (see bends); point on Grove's axis at the axis of Fenner's upper (north-east) leg; the water pipes meet at about (4510,3830)
Iroquis (20 ft) meets Judson at a very acute angle; its mouth is at about (5228,5763), the point is where Iroquis's axis reaches Judson's axis

at the right (binding) edge, ~30 px from the fold: Holden (NOT OPEN, 50 ft) centre taken 25 ft beyond block 6's line (x~6283); Iroquis's 50 ft section lies beyond Holden, centre 25 ft from its east line (y~5352). Same junction as sheet 513 (255,1286)

bends.note: Western turns from the 60 ft SE-NW diagonal into the 40 ft north leg (lots 2701-2717) running to Carll
Fenner changes direction at Grove: the leg toward Baltimore runs more nearly north-south
Judson turns from its diagonal to run due west (straight down the sheet) to Boardman (lots 1670/1671)

notes: Sheet is drawn with NORTH TO THE LEFT (compass fleur-de-lis points left): sheet-up = east, sheet-right = south, sheet-down = west. Carll runs down the left edge, Baltimore Av. (60 ft) parallel to it at x~1650-2020, Linden (north of Baltimore) and Boardman (south of Baltimore) along the bottom edge, Holden (NOT OPEN, 50 ft) along the right edge, Western Av. diagonally across the top. Western Av. is 60 ft on the diagonal and 40 ft on its short north leg between Baltimore and Carll (width list gives 60). Not picked (centres off the paper): Western/Dempsey (above the top edge), Fenner/Judson (beyond the right edge; on sheet 513), and every crossing with Linden/Boardman along the bottom (only their east faces are drawn, y~7590-7690, and the paper ends at y~7700; the C-D match line runs along Boardman's face). Judson's west leg (x 4277-4600) runs off the bottom edge toward Boardman. Linden is labelled '25' at the bottom edge (only part of its width shown); no width recorded. Iroquis is printed IROQUIS (Iroquois).
